title: About Time
about: A young man finds out the men in his family can travel back in time and uses it to find love and make the most of life.
cue: Serve the main when Tim and Mary meet at the dinner in the dark.
faces: Dad told me the family secret on my twenty first. These days I try to live each day once, but properly.
